proof_summary: Take the composite number \(n=23492890653051=3\cdot37\cdot43\cdot42307\cdot116341\). Using \(\sum_{k=1}^n\gcd(k,n)=\sum_{d\mid n}d\varphi(n/d)\) and multiplicativity, the sum is \(\prod_{p\mid n}(2p-1)=610815156979325\), so one plus it equals \(26n\), making the defining gcd equal to \(n\) and the quotient equal to \(1\).
